name: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi
summary: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi provides heavy lifting and transportation services with engineering solutions in Turkey, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers load out services, equipment rental, and trnkey solutions for renewable energy solutions, as well as rigging engineering and transport survey consultancy. The company also provides project planning, route surveys, lift engineering, project management, and installation services. It serves petrochemical, construction, energy, shipyard, and power industries, as well as offshore projects. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
